violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE PREVIOUSLY HANDLING RAW BEEF PATTIES CHANGE GLOVES TO PREPARE SALAD BOWL WITHOUT WASHING HANDS BEFORE REPLACING GLOVES.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE GLOVES, WASH HANDS AND REPLACE WITH CLEAN GLOVES. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES WASH HANDS BETWEEN TASK AND AFTER REPLACING GLOVES.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at handwashing sink @ SHAKES BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC PROVIDED HAND SOAP HANDWASHING SINK DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of 0 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. USE HIGH TEMPERATURE SANITIZING DISHWASHING MACHINE IN BACK KITCHEN UNTIL BAR UNIT HAS BEEN REPAIRED. PLEASE EMAIL EHS WHEN DISHWASHING MACHINE HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: FRIED ONIONS AT 117F ON KITCHEN COUNTER
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS RECOMMENDED PIC TO USE TIME AS PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL (TPHC) FOR FRIED ONIONS WITH START TEMP OF 135F FOR 4 HOURS. PIC CREATED TPHC FOOD LOG DURING INSPECTION. EHS WILL FORWARD TPHC DOCUMENTATION TO PIC. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: BRUSSEL SPROUTS AT 81F AND FALAFEL AT 76F ON TOP OF HOSHIZAKI 2 DOOR PREP TOP; HOMEMADE RANCH DRESSING AT 45F IN HOSHIZAKI 2 DOOR PREP TOP; SHREDDED LETTUCE AT 44F, SLICED TOMATOES AT 46F, SHREDDED CABBAGE MIX AT 48F AND HOMEMADE RANCH DRESSING AT 60F IN HOSHIZAKI 3 DOOR PREP TOP; BUTTERMILK AT 44F IN 1 DOOR UNDER CERTAIN UNIT
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED TCS FOODS IN PREP TOP AND UNDER COUNTER UNITS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS OVERNIGHT IN PREP TOP UNITS UNTIL UNITS CAN MAINTAIN TCS FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW; REQUEST SERVICE FOR UNITS NOT ABLE TO MAINTAIN FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW. PIC CREATED TPHC FOOD LOG DURING INSPECTION. TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL DOCUMENTATION WILL BE FORWARDED TO PIC FOR BRUSSEL SPROUTS AND FALAFEL. BIG BUNS (Inspection Date: 03/04/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: CONTINENTAL 4 DRAWER UNDER COUNTER (GRILL) AT 45F AND 1 DOOR UNDER COUNTER AT 44F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCE UNITS HAVE BEEN REPAIRED.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system AT MOP SINK FAUCET CONNECTED TO CHEMICAL DISPENSING SYSTEM.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PLEASE INSTALL APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE WITHIN 3 DAYS AND FORWARD EVIDENCE OF PURCHASE AND SUBSEQUENT INSTALLATION TO EHS.
